worker.title: Worker
worker.directoryPlaceholder: Enter a Project directory in the Worker execution environment
worker.directoryOutsideWorkspace: Choose /workspace or a subdirectory to start or resume a Worker Instance. Symlinks must also resolve within /workspace.
worker.providerLogin: Sign in or reauthenticate your provider in native OpenCode Web.
worker.capacityAvailable: Worker's current execution environment is available to start or resume an Instance.
worker.capacityFull: Worker's current execution environment is occupied. Stop its current Instance before starting or resuming.
worker.capacityUnknown: Worker's current execution capacity could not be verified. Refresh or recheck before starting or resuming.
worker.workspaceStartHint: Instances can only start in /workspace or its subdirectories
worker.browseOutsideWorkspace: This directory is outside /workspace. You can browse or save a shortcut; return to /workspace to start an Instance.
worker.description: Operates independently, not managed by a Coordinator. Use one Instance at a time. Project directories belong to the Worker execution environment.
worker.credentials: Worker credentials are managed by the deployment. Your browser will request a separate login for native Web.
